one_line: Karkota ruler of Kashmir whose ambitious digvijaya legend wraps a real era of Himalayan power, diplomacy, and cultural building.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, tall and athletic with a regal, commanding presence.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium wheat complexion with a faint Kashmiri rose undertone, sharp nose, defined jaw, straight brows, eyes slightly large in anime style with calm intensity, default expression a poised, thoughtful half-smile suggesting strategic confidence.
appearance.hair: Straight, dark brown-black hair, shoulder-length and neatly combed back, tied in a low knot at the nape; front shows a subtle center part with two loose side locks framing the cheeks; crowned by a modest golden kulāh-like circlet with a small central green gemstone and a thin cloth band of deep red wrapped beneath it.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved Kashmiri royal tunic (anga) of rich saffron silk falling to mid-thigh, with fine woven borders in deep red and muted green forming simple geometric and vine patterns; over it a soft, full-length woolen shawl (pashmina-style) in muted cream with subtle light grey paisley motifs, draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back like a dignified upper garment; the lower garment is a pleated dhoti-style wrap in natural off-white cotton, tied securely at the waist and falling to the ankles, with a narrow deep red border; on his feet, brown leather strapped sandals suitable for travel across varied terrain; jewellery is restrained but royal—two slim gold armlets on the upper arms, a short gold necklace with a single green stone pendant, and simple gold studs in the ears; overall the textiles look practical yet regal, fitting an 8th-century Kashmiri king who moves between court, pilgrimage sites, and diplomatic journeys.
appearance.signature: A finely crafted steel straight sword of early Indian type with a slightly broad blade, a simple cross-guard, and a dark wooden hilt capped with a small gold pommel, carried sheathed in a plain brown leather scabbard with minimal gold fittings, worn at his left hip as a symbol of royal authority rather than an exaggerated battle weapon.

ref_desc: Lalitaditya Muktapida is a mid-30s Kashmiri king with shoulder-length dark hair in a low knot, saffron tunic, cream wool shawl, off-white dhoti, modest gold circlet and jewellery, carrying a sheathed straight steel sword, in saffron, deep red, cream, muted green, and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Lalitaditya Muktapida: a mid-30s Kashmiri king, tall and athletic, with an oval medium wheat-toned face, calm intense eyes, and shoulder-length dark brown-black hair combed back into a low knot with two loose side locks. He wears a modest golden circlet with a small central green gemstone and a deep red cloth band beneath it. His costume is an 8th-century Kashmiri royal outfit: a rich saffron silk tunic with long sleeves and fine deep red and muted green geometric-vine borders, a full-length cream woolen shawl with subtle light grey paisley motifs draped from the left shoulder across his chest and around his back, and a neatly pleated off-white cotton dhoti-style lower garment with a narrow deep red border falling to his ankles. Show simple brown leather strapped sandals on his feet. Add restrained royal jewellery: two slim gold armlets, a short gold necklace with a single green stone pendant, and small gold stud earrings. At his left hip, show his signature straight steel sword sheathed in a plain brown leather scabbard with minimal gold fittings, held as a symbol of authority. Use saffron, deep red, cream, muted green, and brown as the dominant colours, and present him in a neutral front-facing pose suitable for consistent redrawing.
